descriptions.w3d_d27e_read_string_refs_80202044: Reads n string indices through 0x802024f4 and, when an output array is given, stores the matching entry of the name table at +140 in each slot: the new string's 16-bit reference count at -6 goes up, the old one's goes down and it is freed at zero. Strings are viewed as raw character pointers here. Names are inferred.
